entry.title: [Technical review] BiDi - Add page for log module event
entry.content:
Description

This PR adds a page for the log.entryAdded event, the only one event in the log module (it has no commands).

Also:

  • Updated the log.entryAdded example in the modules landing page.
  • Added a list of the event notification fields to the overview Events section.
    This now makes it parallel to the command message fields in the Commands section.

Spec link

https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#module-log

For editorial review

Since this is the first page of its kind (a BiDi event), I've added the webdriver-event page-type to the front-matter-config.json file.

Related issue

Doc issue: mdn/mdn#339

entry.title: Fixed typo in getDay() range - was 1-7 now 0-6
entry.content:

getDay() range incorrectly mentioned as one-indexed (1-7) instead of zero-indexed (0-6)

Motivation

Fixing typo/incorrect content

Change suggested based on getDay() docs:

entry.title: Issue 21826: Restore browser-extension-template recommendation
entry.content:
Description

The recommendation for using browser-extension-template to set up an extension project was removed from the Build a cross-browser extension page in October 2022. At that time, the template was updated to Manifest V3, but the how-to page has not been updated.

The how-to page has been updated to cover Manifest V3, so the recommendation can be restored.

Related issues and pull requests

Fixes #121826

entry.title: Technical review: Document meta text-scale and env(preferred-text-scale)
entry.content:
Description

Chrome has added support for two features that allow sites to size fonts in proportion to the operating system/browser text scale settings:

  • The <meta name="text-scale" content="..." /> element, which was added in Chrome 146, and works across Desktop and Mobile platforms. See https://chromestatus.com/feature/5112244702674944.
  • The preferred-text-scale env() variable, which was added in Chrome 138. This only really works in Android,

This PR documents both of these features.

Motivation

Additional details

entry.content:

It also adds a minor clarification to the JS doc.

entry.title: Remove 504'ed WebKit Trac link
entry.content:

The pseudo element ::-webkit-inner-spin-button page property has a reference link below the See also section:

  • [Styling Form Controls – WebKit

As part of Apple's restructuring documentation, this link doesn't work anymore and is returning a 504 server error.
I propose removing it from the page.

Motivation

Clean up the documentation and avoid reference confusion.
